description: We are  Seed to Satellite, a team  who enjoy learning, sharing ideas and working together to make a difference. We are interested in science, technology and innovation. We believe that every team member brings something valuable and that combining different skills and helps us develop better ideas, solve problems. We are looking for people who are passionate, responsible, open to new ideas. Skills in programming, research, design, agriculture ,data analysis would be a great addition to our team.
